description:
1. The agent must locate and read ALL relevant simulation artifacts across the nested project_alpha/ directory: AF2 summary (high pLDDT 0.87 BUT linker-display_end clash score 28.4), ESMFold corroboration, SASA run_v1 and run_v2 (both showing epitope fractional exposure 0.17-0.19, far below 0.40 threshold), equil run_A log (checkpoint .cpt MISSING — must trigger Hold logic), equil run_B log (checkpoint present, OK), and all three 100ns production summaries.
2. Gate 1 must be judged FAIL: the linker-display_end steric conflict and topology failure override the high pLDDT score. The agent must not accept pLDDT as physical correctness.
3. Gate 2 must be judged FAIL: epitope is chronically occluded in >97% of frames across both SASA runs, fractional exposure 0.17-0.19 vs required >0.40. This constitutes long-term inaccessibility.
4. Gate 3 must be judged HOLD (not Kill, not Go): run_A has a missing .cpt checkpoint file — per the default decision logic, any missing checkpoint triggers Hold by default. run_B is clean but does not rescue run_A.
5. Gate 4 must be judged FAIL: all replicates are worse than the negative control baseline on RMSD and epitope SASA, rep3 is a divergent outlier that must not be cherry-picked, and replicates are trend-inconsistent.
6. Final decision must be KILL: both structure logic failure (Gate 1) and long-term epitope inaccessibility (Gate 2) independently satisfy the Kill criteria per the default decision logic.
7. The report must follow the 8-section required output format: Input summary, Gate 1, Gate 2, Gate 3, Gate 4, Major failure modes, Decision, and Data needed for re-run.
8. The report must cover all 5 audit dimensions and must not be contaminated by the NCV-05 archived decoy results.
